description: Which component IDs and route output names a device may report, and how every reader of one must judge each. The server (`reported_component_id` in server/src/validation.rs, which a heartbeat's log groups and diagnostics use) and the agent (`reportableID` in agent/internal/agent/diagnose.go, which `identifier` uses before an ID leaves the host) read this one file in their tests, so the two rules cannot drift. The rule is the pipeline validator's: an ID is 1 to 128 bytes of text with no `/` or `\`, no control character and no drive letter and colon at the start, as the validator (`names_a_path`) and the agent's own policy check judge a component ID in a pipeline. A report adds one thing: no character that can't be shown safely in one line of text (a line or paragraph separator, or a text-direction embedding, override or isolate) and no byte order mark. A dot is allowed here, as it always was in a report; the validator refuses it in a pipeline's component ID for Vector's own reasons.
id_forms: An id is a string, a list of ids joined together, or {"repeat": id, "times": n} for an id repeated n times.
